elaine_ops: Policy update: starting today were changing reservation priority behavior for Dedicated pools in us-west-2. Aim is to reduce long tail wait times for small PLG customers while keeping enterprise reserved slots predictable.

sam_infra: TL;DR: reservation priority now considers (1) contract tier, (2) reservation size, and (3) queue wait time. Small reservations (<4 GPUs) will get a small boost after 30m of queueing. Large reservations still respect reserved-first for enterprise.

elaine_ops: Rationale: we saw many 1-2 GPU PLG reservations stuck behind large reserved blocks for >12h. This tweak should improve developer experience without impacting committed capacity.

sam_infra: Config excerpt (deployed to infra-config -> `services/dedicated/policies/prioritization.yaml`):

```yaml
prioritization:
  tiers:
    - name: enterprise
      weight: 100
    - name: standard
      weight: 50
    - name: free_plg
      weight: 30
  small_reservation_boost:
    enabled: true
    gpu_threshold: 4
    boost_score: 20
    wait_threshold: 1800  # seconds
```

deploy-bot: infra-config v1.40 deployed by sam_infra [32m:white_check_mark:[0m deploy id `deploy-2026-03-23-1540`

paul_sre: Monitoring added: `reservation_priority_score`, `queue_depth_by_size`, `reservations_preempted_count`. Temporary alert: if `reservations_preempted_count>5` in 1h, auto-roll back and page oncall.

tara_cs: Heads up CS + support templates: customers with enterprise contracts will see no change to their guaranteed placements. For PLG users, they may notice quicker fulfills for small reservations. Draft status blurb: "We updated Dedicated reservation prioritization in us-west-2 to improve fulfillment times for small reservations. No action needed."

maria_sales: Will this affect pricing? Not immediately. If we need to expand capacity to meet new demand, we'll present options to customers.

sam_infra: Rollout plan: gradual enablement in us-west-2 only for 24h, observe metrics, then enable in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 next week if stable. Rollback plan: set `small_reservation_boost.enabled=false` and redeploy.

elaine_ops: Please review the runbook change I pushed to Confluence: "Dedicated prioritization v1.1". If youre oncall please monitor `queue_age_p95` and `small_reservation_fulfill_rate`.

status-bot: Status page updated: "Dedicated reservation prioritization change active in us-west-2 (observability on)."

paul_sre: Ill watch the alerts this AM; reach out if you see unexpected preemptions.

elaine_ops: Thanks team. Post any customer feedback to this thread or ping me directly. :megaphone:
